t: 康拉德二世,神圣罗马皇帝成为勃艮第国王.
te: Conrad II, Holy Roman Emperor becomes king of Burgundy.
dz: 康拉德二世,神圣罗马皇帝成为勃艮第国王.
de: Conrad II, Holy Roman Emperor becomes king of Burgundy.

t: 教宗约翰十二世加冕奥托一世,神圣罗马皇帝,是近40年来第一位神圣罗马皇帝.
te: Pope John XII crowns Otto I, Holy Roman Emperor, the first Holy Roman Emperor in nearly 40 years.
dz: 特兰斯拉提欧活佛:教宗约翰十二世加冕奥托一世,神圣罗马皇帝,是近40年来第一位神圣罗马皇帝.
de: Translatio imperii: Pope John XII crowns Otto I, Holy Roman Emperor, the first Holy Roman Emperor in nearly 40 years.

t: 法国国王路易三世被诺斯大希森军队击败于萨克森的吕恩堡海斯.
te: King Louis III of France is defeated by the Norse Great Heathen Army at Lüneburg Heath in Saxony.
dz: 吕恩堡海斯战役:法国国王路易三世被诺斯大希森军队击败于萨克森的吕恩堡海斯.
de: Battle of Lüneburg Heath: King Louis III of France is defeated by the Norse Great Heathen Army at Lüneburg Heath in Saxony.

dz: 维西哥特人第八任国王阿拉里克二世颁布阿拉里克的布列维里(Breviarium Alaricianum或Lex Romana Visigothorum),是"罗马法"的集合.
de: Alaric II, eighth king of the Visigoths, promulgates the Breviary of Alaric (Breviarium Alaricianum or Lex Romana Visigothorum), a collection of "Roman law".
